# People Atlas 0.12.3 — Alpha

> [!WARNING]
> People Atlas 0.12.3 is an alpha version of the plugin. Its fundamental
> behavior is subject to change in future releases.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Compatibility: People Atlas 0.12.3 only supports Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer.
> Obsidian 1.12.x and older are not supported.**

People Atlas 0.12.3 refines person and relationship selection safety, improves
the relationship editing experience, and hardens the release pipeline.

> [!NOTE]
> Publishing People Atlas in the Community Plugins directory remains a separate
> step from this GitHub prerelease.

## Changes

- **In-plugin relationship picker:** relationship editing now uses the People
  Atlas picker instead of the native picker.
- **Privacy-safe person mentions:** person mentions no longer expose vault
  paths in the rendered interface.
- **Conflict-safe person resolution:** conflicting references fail closed rather
  than resolving to a potentially incorrect canonical person.
- **Unicode-safe settings:** YAML property names are handled without corrupting
  Unicode characters.
- **Release hardening:** the release supply chain has additional safeguards.

## Breaking change / upgrade note

People Atlas 0.12.3 continues the fresh-vault-only boundary for the
presentation-first dossier layout. It does not migrate older folder layouts or
provide a backward-compatibility path for them.

## Assets

Install or update the plugin with the attached `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and
`styles.css`.
